syntax = "proto3"; package demo.v1; option go_package = "example.com/demo/v1"; message User { string name = 1; int32 age = 2; repeated string tags = 3; enum Role { ROLE_UNSPECIFIED = 0; ROLE_ADMIN = 1; } Role role = 4; } service UserService { rpc GetUser(UserRequest) returns (User); rpc ListUsers(UserRequest) returns (stream User); }
